n_intro.text: Meet Receptly — the AI receptionist that never misses a call.

n_problem.text: When you're busy with a client, or the salon is closed, calls go unanswered. And every missed call is a lost booking.

n_landing.text: With Receptly, Ava answers every call — on your phone line, or right from your website.

c1.text: Thank you for calling Luma Hair Studio, this is Ava. This call may be recorded and transcribed. How can I help you today?

c2.text: Hi! Can I get a haircut with Sara tomorrow afternoon?

c3.text: Sara has 2:30 PM or 4:00 PM tomorrow. Which works best for you?

c5.text: Lovely — a haircut with Sara tomorrow at 2:30 PM, for Ayesha Khan. Shall I book it?

c7.text: You're all set! A confirmation email is on its way. Anything else I can help with?

n_booked.text: The appointment lands straight in Google Calendar, and the customer gets a confirmation email, instantly.

n_overview.text: Your dashboard shows every call, every booking, and how your receptionist is doing.

n_detail.text: Open any call to see the full transcript, every action Ava took, and an AI summary for your team.

n_teach.text: Teach Ava your services, prices, opening hours and FAQs in minutes. No code needed.

n_trust.text: And it's built to be trusted. Ava only offers times that are really free, never double-books, and hands off to a person whenever a caller asks.

n_mobile.text: Your front desk, in your pocket.

n_outro.text: Receptly. Never miss a call again.
